spec.expr: sum(sum by (pod) (nginx_http_connections{namespace="$namespace", state="active"}))

spec.description: Accepted client connections across all selected pods (http + stream, idle keepalive included).
spec.title: Active client connections

spec.expr: max(sum by (pod) (nginx_http_connections{namespace="$namespace", state=~"active|writing"} or label_replace(nginx_stream_connections_active{namespace="$namespace"}, "leg", "stream_upstream", "", "")))

spec.description:
Connection slots used by the busiest pod.

Slots = what worker_connections actually counts: accepted client connections (http + stream, from stub_status), plus the upstream leg of every in-flight request (≈ state=writing: fastcgi to FPM / proxy), plus the upstream leg of every open stream tunnel (redis / rabbitmq / database). It's an estimate: idle upstream keepalive connections are not visible.

Limit = nginx_connection_slots_limit (worker_connections × workers, exported per pod by the Lua exporter). worker_connections is per worker; with >1 worker the pod total is only reachable if load spreads evenly.
spec.title: Busiest pod · slots used

spec.description: Highest connection-slot limit among the selected pods: nginx_connection_slots_limit (worker_connections × workers), exported by the Lua exporter.
spec.title: Slot limit per pod

spec.expr: max(sum by (pod) (nginx_http_connections{namespace="$namespace", state=~"active|writing"} or label_replace(nginx_stream_connections_active{namespace="$namespace"}, "leg", "stream_upstream", "", "")) / on (pod) max by (pod) (nginx_connection_slots_limit{namespace="$namespace"}))

spec.description:
Busiest pod: slots used / limit.

Slots = what worker_connections actually counts: accepted client connections (http + stream, from stub_status), plus the upstream leg of every in-flight request (≈ state=writing: fastcgi to FPM / proxy), plus the upstream leg of every open stream tunnel (redis / rabbitmq / database). It's an estimate: idle upstream keepalive connections are not visible.

Limit = nginx_connection_slots_limit (worker_connections × workers, exported per pod by the Lua exporter). worker_connections is per worker; with >1 worker the pod total is only reachable if load spreads evenly.
spec.title: Peak slot utilization

spec.expr: sum(nginx_http_connections{namespace="$namespace", state="waiting"})

spec.description: Connections open but idle, waiting for the next request on keepalive.
spec.title: Idle keepalive (waiting)

spec.description: Currently open L4 sessions (redis / rabbitmq / database) across selected pods. Each one costs 2 slots.
spec.title: Open stream tunnels

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (nginx_http_connections{namespace="$namespace", state=~"active|writing"} or label_replace(nginx_stream_connections_active{namespace="$namespace"}, "leg", "stream_upstream", "", ""))
max(nginx_connection_slots_limit{namespace="$namespace"})

spec.description:
Absolute connection slots per pod against the limit (red dashed, highest among selected pods).

Slots = what worker_connections actually counts: accepted client connections (http + stream, from stub_status), plus the upstream leg of every in-flight request (≈ state=writing: fastcgi to FPM / proxy), plus the upstream leg of every open stream tunnel (redis / rabbitmq / database). It's an estimate: idle upstream keepalive connections are not visible.

Limit = nginx_connection_slots_limit (worker_connections × workers, exported per pod by the Lua exporter). worker_connections is per worker; with >1 worker the pod total is only reachable if load spreads evenly.
spec.title: Connection slots used vs limit (per pod)

spec.expr: sum by (state) (nginx_http_connections{namespace="$namespace", state=~"reading|writing|waiting"})
sum(nginx_stream_connections_active{namespace="$namespace"})

spec.description: Raw stub_status counts, stacked. reading = reading request headers, writing = request in flight (incl. waiting on FPM/upstream), waiting = idle keepalive. reading + writing + waiting = active. Stream tunnels (upstream leg) shown separately.
spec.title: Connection states (all selected pods)

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (nginx_http_connections{namespace="$namespace", state=~"active|writing"} or label_replace(nginx_stream_connections_active{namespace="$namespace"}, "leg", "stream_upstream", "", "")) / on (pod) max by (pod) (nginx_connection_slots_limit{namespace="$namespace"})

spec.description:
Slots used / limit per pod.

Slots = what worker_connections actually counts: accepted client connections (http + stream, from stub_status), plus the upstream leg of every in-flight request (≈ state=writing: fastcgi to FPM / proxy), plus the upstream leg of every open stream tunnel (redis / rabbitmq / database). It's an estimate: idle upstream keepalive connections are not visible.

Limit = nginx_connection_slots_limit (worker_connections × workers, exported per pod by the Lua exporter). worker_connections is per worker; with >1 worker the pod total is only reachable if load spreads evenly.
spec.title: Connection slot utilization (of limit, per pod)

spec.expr: sum(nginx_http_connections{state="writing", namespace="$namespace"}) by (pod) / sum(nginx_http_connections{state="active", namespace="$namespace"}) by (pod)

spec.description: High ratio means nginx is busy sending responses — useful for spotting slow clients or large payloads.
spec.title: Writing / active ratio (response concurrency)

spec.description:
How many active connections are actually doing work?

0–5% → mostly idle traffic / keepalive

5–30% → healthy traffic

30–70% → heavy utilization

above 70% sustained → pod may be overloaded or upstream slow

100% → suspicious, saturation risk

This tells you whether nginx is spending time serving traffic vs idle keepalive.
spec.title: Busy connection ratio

spec.expr: max by (pod) (max_over_time(nginx_connection_requests{namespace="$namespace"}[$__interval]))

spec.description: Gauge nginx_connection_requests: request number on the connection of the latest request in each pod (max per interval). Stuck at 1 = clients open a new connection per request → churn, TIME_WAIT, more slots. Last-value gauge, so it samples, not a distribution.
spec.title: Keepalive reuse · requests on connection (last seen, per pod)

spec.expr: max by (pod) (max_over_time(nginx_connection_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace"}[$__interval]))

spec.description: Gauge nginx_connection_time_seconds: how long the connection of the latest request in each pod had been open (max per interval). Short ages with low reuse = churn. Last-value gauge, so it samples, not a distribution.
spec.title: Connection age at request time (last seen, per pod)

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (nginx_stream_connections_active{namespace="$namespace"})

spec.description: Currently open L4 sessions per pod, by caller. Each tunnel = client leg + upstream leg.
spec.title: Open stream tunnels (per pod)

spec.expr:
label_join(
  label_join(
  avg(nginx_stream_upstream_connect_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", status=~"${status:pipe}"}) by (destination, upstream_addr, status, source_namespace, source_service),
  "statusdestinationupstream_addr", ":", "status", "destination", "upstream_addr"
),
  "statusdestinationupstream_addrsource_namespacesource_service", ":", "statusdestinationupstream_addr", "source_namespace", "source_service"
)

label_join(
  label_join(
  avg(nginx_stream_session_duration_seconds{namespace="$namespace", status=~"${status:pipe}"}) by (destination, upstream_addr, status, source_namespace, source_service),
  "statusdestinationupstream_addr", ":", "status", "destination", "upstream_addr"
),
  "statusdestinationupstream_addrsource_namespacesource_service", ":", "statusdestinationupstream_addr", "source_namespace", "source_service"
)

spec.description: TCP (stream) connections proxied by nginx to databases, redis and rabbitmq in the last 30 s, with connect time and session duration.
spec.title: L4 Stream Status

spec.expr: sum by (state, source_namespace, source_service) (nginx_stream_connections_active{namespace="$namespace", state="active"}) > 0
sum by (state, source_namespace, source_service) (nginx_stream_connections_active{namespace="$namespace", state!="active"}) > 0

spec.description: Currently open stream connections by state and source.
spec.title: Outgoing stream connection count per state - source

spec.description: New upstream TCP connections per interval by status and destination.
spec.title: Outgoing upstream connection count per status - source → destination

spec.expr: avg(nginx_stream_session_duration_seconds{namespace="$namespace", status=~"${status:pipe}", destination="database"}) by (destination, upstream_addr, status, source_namespace, source_service) > 0
avg(nginx_stream_session_duration_seconds{namespace="$namespace", status=~"${status:pipe}", destination="redis"}) by (destination, upstream_addr, status, source_namespace, source_service) > 0
avg(nginx_stream_session_duration_seconds{namespace="$namespace", status=~"${status:pipe}", destination="rabbitmq"}) by (destination, upstream_addr, status, source_namespace, source_service) > 0

spec.description: Duration of TCP sessions to upstreams (database / redis / rabbitmq).
spec.title: Average of last outgoing upstream session duration per status - source → destination

spec.expr: avg(nginx_stream_upstream_connect_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", destination="database", status=~"${status:pipe}"}) by (destination, upstream_addr, status, source_namespace, source_service) > 0
avg(nginx_stream_upstream_connect_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", destination="redis", status=~"${status:pipe}"}) by (destination, upstream_addr, status, source_namespace, source_service) > 0
avg(nginx_stream_upstream_connect_time_seconds{namespace="$namespace", destination="rabbitmq", status=~"${status:pipe}"}) by (destination, upstream_addr, status, source_namespace, source_service) > 0
